subject: SIG questionnaire: control mapping scope and evidence handover (NovusBank)
messages:
From: Heather Lin <heather@novusbank.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, procure@novusbank.com
Date: 2028-06-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire intake and preferred evidence cadence

Hi Priya,

We received the SIG questionnaire from our vendor assessment team and started an initial pass. To keep momentum on the NovusBank procurement timeline, can you confirm:  

- Whether Redwood will provide a single control map that cross-references SIG controls to your SOC 2 / ISO 27001 attestations (preferred), or separate mapping tables.
- Whether you can deliver evidence in batched increments (e.g., control groups A–C on Jun 13, remainder on Jun 20) rather than one big bundle.
- Preferred formats for evidence (Excel mapping + PDFs preferred here).

Additionally, we will need a short SOC 2 summary and a KMS key rotation excerpt for key controls around encryption and key management. Our procurement portal has ticket #98421 for uploads — I'll attach the portal link below.

Are you available for a quick 30-minute walkthrough next week to align on scoping (production vs dev controls, third-party subservice providers)?

Thanks,
Heather
Heather Lin
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
NovusBank

Attachments referenced: none
From: priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Heather Lin <heather@novusbank.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire intake and preferred evidence cadence

Hi Heather — thanks for the clear ask and the portal ticket. We can absolutely support a batched delivery; that works better operationally for us. Proposed plan below:  

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- Jun 13: Deliver SIG->SOC2/ISO control crosswalk (spreadsheet), SOC2 summary (PDF), and initial set of artifact PDFs for identity/access controls (IAM) and network segmentation.
- Jun 20: Deliver KMS rotation excerpt, audit-config screenshots, and additional artifacts for change management and logging controls.
- Jun 27: Final batch for third-party attestations and remaining logs (redacted where necessary).

Format: Control crosswalk in Excel (xlsx), artifacts as PDFs or CSV extracts for logs. We will attach filenames in the portal ticket and share a Drive folder for easy preview.

I am sharing a first-pass control map (sig_control_map_v1.xlsx) in the Drive link below for your intake team to review. Jonas and Marcus are looped in to confirm the scope on encryption and telemetry evidence.

Yes — we can do a 30-min walkthrough. Are you available Jun 11 at 10:00am PT or Jun 12 at 2:00pm PT?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Security Manager, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Attachments: sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (stub: Excel mapping file)
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Heather Lin <heather@novusbank.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire intake and preferred evidence cadence

On Tue, Jun 4, 2028 at 11:02 AM priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> I am sharing a first-pass control map (sig_control_map_v1.xlsx) in the Drive link below for your intake team to review.

Thanks, Priya — quick clarifying points from the technical side we should confirm before the walkthrough:  

- Scope: Do you require production-only evidence for all controls, or will dev/staging artifacts be acceptable for non-prod controls? (We usually provide prod for crypto, prod or restricted staging for onboarding flows.)
- Encryption/KMS: The KMS rotation log excerpt we can provide is a CSV export of rotation events; is a 90-day window acceptable or do you need historical rotations back to 12 months?
- Telemetry/logs: For logging controls, would you accept aggregated, redacted log samples + retention policy screenshot, or do you need raw logs (we will redacted PII if shared).

If you confirm, we will prepare the Jun 13 batch accordingly. Also, happy to run the 30-min walkthrough — Jun 11 10:00am PT works for me.

Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
From: Heather Lin <heather@novusbank.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire intake and preferred evidence cadence

Priya / Jonas — appreciate the quick turnaround. We uploaded a procurement ticket (98421) and added a note that Novus can accept batched delivery. A couple decisions from our end:  

- Production artifacts are preferred for crypto/KMS controls. If you can provide a 12-month rotation summary that would be ideal; if not, provide 90 days and flag where full history is unavailable.
- For logging controls we can accept aggregated/redacted samples and a retention policy screenshot for the initial batch; we may request raw logs later under strict redaction rules.

I've attached two items into our portal upload: a brief intake template and a placeholder statement on redaction requirements (procurement will not accept unredacted PII). See link: https://records.procure.novusbank.com/ticket/98421

We confirm Jun 11 10:00am PT for the walkthrough. Heather

Heather Lin
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager, NovusBank

Attachments referenced: intake_template.docx (portal), redaction_guidance.pdf (portal)
From: priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Heather Lin <heather@novusbank.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire intake and preferred evidence cadence

Thanks Heather — confirmed for Jun 11 10:00am PT. Following up with what we'll deliver and when so Novus procurement has a clear checklist:  

Planned deliveries into ticket #98421 and Drive folder (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Novus/SIG/ControlMap):
- Jun 13: sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (crosswalk), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, IAM_artifacts_batch1.pdf (user provisioning screenshots), network-segmentation-diagram.pdf
- Jun 20: kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv (90-day export) and kms_rotation_metadata.json (metadata stub for auditors), change-management-artifacts.pdf
- Jun 27: third-party attestations (vendor PDFs) and remaining log samples (redacted CSVs)

Notes and exceptions:
- We will provide a 90-day rotation CSV by Jun 20. If you require a 12-month rotation audit, we can generate a longer export but it will need additional redaction and will slip the final batch by ~3 business days.
- All log samples will be redacted to remove PII before upload; we will include a redaction index file with every batch.

Walkthrough agenda for Jun 11 (30 min):
- 5 min: Introductions and scope confirmation (prod vs non-prod)
- 10 min: Walk through control crosswalk and artifact mapping
- 10 min: Evidence formats, redaction constraints, and portal upload process
- 5 min: Qs and next steps

If that looks good I will send a calendar invite and attach the Jun 13 deliverables checklist. Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Security Manager, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Attachments to be uploaded: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (stub), kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv (stub)
